dashboard.description: Good-bot health and governance posture. L0 freshness + success rate + bot-health delta, L1 AI crawler attribution (sources, paths), L2 policy surface evidence and 429 watch.

panels.description: Minutes since most recent ingested event. LIVE = data flowing. STALE = pipeline delay. DOWN = no data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time,
  greatest(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), now()), 0) AS lag_minutes
FROM ${summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Data freshness trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: 2xx success rate for governance pages (robots.txt, llms.txt). Should be above 98%. Below 90% is critical -- crawlers cannot discover your site policies.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time,
  cnt_2xx / greatest(cnt_all, 1) * 100 AS value
FROM ${summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND resource_category IN ('robots.txt', 'sitemap.xml', 'ads.txt', 'llms.txt')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Policy page success rate trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: AI Source Composition

panels.description: ASNs ranked by AI crawler traffic volume, broken out by country.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    client_asn,
    client_country_iso_code
  FROM ${raw_table}
  WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
    AND notEmpty(ai_category)
)
SELECT
  client_asn,
  client_country_iso_code,
  count() AS vol,
  round(count() * 100.0 / greatest((SELECT count() FROM filtered), 1), 2) AS share_pct
FROM filtered
GROUP BY client_asn, client_country_iso_code
ORDER BY vol DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top AI sources; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Status code breakdown for each governance endpoint type (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, ads.txt, llms.txt). One row per resource_category. Any non-2xx response is actionable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  resource_category,
  cnt_all AS total,
  cnt_2xx / greatest(cnt_all, 1) * 100 AS pct_2xx,
  cnt_4xx / greatest(cnt_all, 1) * 100 AS pct_4xx,
  cnt_429 / greatest(cnt_all, 1) * 100 AS pct_429,
  cnt_5xx / greatest(cnt_all, 1) * 100 AS pct_5xx
FROM ${summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND resource_category IN ('robots.txt', 'sitemap.xml', 'ads.txt', 'llms.txt')
GROUP BY resource_category
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 100
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Policy surface health (status mix); du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: 429 rate by known good-bot family. Any sustained 429 rate against Googlebot or Bingbot means rate-limiting rules are incorrectly scoped and need immediate adjustment. Target: 0% for all good bots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  bot_class,
  cnt_all AS total,
  cnt_429 AS cnt_429,
  cnt_429 / greatest(cnt_all, 1) * 100 AS rate_429
FROM ${summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND bot_class IN ('search_engine_crawler', 'social_media_crawler', 'monitoring_bot')
GROUP BY bot_class
ORDER BY rate_429 DESC, total DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Good-bot 429 watch; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Good-Bot 429 Watch

panels.description: AI crawler behavior correlated with SIEM enforcement outcomes. Requires SIEM data source. Current SIEM summaries honor site and ASN only; traffic_type and bot_class are unavailable here.

targets.rawSql:
-- AI Crawler SIEM Enrichment [+SIEM] — migrated to SIEM summary
-- Aggregated view by policy_id and action_taken

SELECT
  policy_id,
  action_taken,
  total,
  blocked,
  auth_failures,
  round(avg_score, 1) AS avg_bot_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    policy_id,
    action_taken,
    cnt_all AS total,
    cnt_blocked AS blocked,
    cnt_auth_fail AS auth_failures,
    avg_bot_score AS avg_score
  FROM ${siem_summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND '${siem_available}' = '1'
  GROUP BY policy_id, action_taken
)
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 100
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=AI crawler SIEM enrichment (summary); du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Bot management action summary from SIEM data, grouped by action and policy ID. Requires SIEM data source. Current SIEM summaries honor site and ASN only; traffic_type and bot_class are unavailable here.

targets.rawSql:
-- Bot Manager Action Summary [+SIEM] — migrated to SIEM summary

SELECT
  action_taken,
  policy_id,
  cnt_all AS total,
  cnt_blocked AS blocked,
  cnt_4xx AS client_errors,
  cnt_5xx AS server_errors
FROM ${siem_summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)

  AND '${siem_available}' = '1'

  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot manager action summary (summary); du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Individual request records scoped by the active site, traffic, ASN, and bot-class filters. LIMIT 500, ORDER BY timestamp DESC. SEO-specific columns include ai_category, resource_category, and response_content_type.

defaults.noValue: Apply a filter to view raw logs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  reqTimeSec AS timestamp,
  client_ip,
  client_asn,
  request_method,
  request_host,
  request_path,
  response_status_code,
  bot_class,
  user_agent_category,
  ai_category,
  resource_category,
  response_content_type
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Raw logs scoped evidence; du=${__user.login}'

list.name: duration
list.query: SELECT greatest(dateDiff('hour', toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS duration

list.name: site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT request_host FROM ${summary_table} WHERE 1=1 LIMIT 1000

list.name: siem_available
list.query: SELECT if(count() > 0, '1', '0') AS has_siem FROM (SELECT 1 FROM ${siem_summary_table} LIMIT 1)

list.label: ASN
list.name: client_asn
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT client_asn FROM ${summary_table} WHERE $__adHocFilter() AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site) ORDER BY client_asn LIMIT 1000

list.label: Cohort
list.name: bot_class
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT bot_class FROM ${summary_table} WHERE $__adHocFilter() AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site) ORDER BY bot_class LIMIT 1000
